title: The image of an irreducible subset under a continuous map is irreducible
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces and let $E\subseteq X$ be an irreducible subset [def-weil-irreducible-components] (nonempty, and not the union of two proper closed subsets in the subspace topology). Then $f(E)\subseteq Y$ is irreducible.
